## Change

Describe the problem and the behaviour this PR changes. Link the related issue and its parent when applicable.

## Checks

List the checks you ran and their results. Identify live fleet checks, their acceptance scope and any pending gates. Keep hardware/model selections and raw evidence in private execution records; include a sanitised evidence reference when applicable.

## Review context

For a bug fix, include reproduction steps. Remove credentials, live addresses, private paths and hardware/model identifiers from logs or configuration attached to the PR.
